title: Sixteen photo faces to review
items: A separate review page shows sixteen fictional faces and their photographed front hair on the existing figures, beside their source images and the old appearance, with front and profile controls.

Photo faces retain iris detail and use source-guided eye tone, pupil size and eyelid opening. A single-photo command fits future historical photos for review; the opt-in generic-adult preview shares one small face atlas. Default assignments stay unchanged.
